jobs.title: Principal Product Manager – HR Product Management & Employee Experience
jobs.location: Toronto, ON CAN - 115 Humber College Blvd, Suite 611 INVIVA Etobicoke North (CL9G)
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Role Summary

The Principal Product Manager translates McKesson’s HR product and employee experience strategy into an enterprise product portfolio. Reporting to the VP, HR Product Management & Employee Experience,   this role shapes product strategy across multiple HR products, employee journeys, workforce capabilities, and AI-enabled employee experiences ; influences enterprise prioritization and investment decisions ; and ensures measurable value realization for employees, managers, HR teams, and the business.

This is a senior individual contributor role that operates as a product thought leader and strategic connector across HR, Technology, Employee Experience, Operations, Legal, Privacy, Risk, and Change teams. The role is accountable for portfolio-level product direction, outcome definition, cross-product sequencing, and maturity of product management practices — without formal people-management responsibility.

Enterprise Product Portfolio Strategy

- Define and evolve the product strategy across multiple HR product domains, employee journeys, and workforce capabilities.

- Translate enterprise workforce priorities, employee insights, technology trends, and business needs into multi-year product roadmaps and investment recommendations.

- Identify opportunities to simplify experiences, reduce fragmentation, improve adoption, and create more connected end-to-end HR experiences.

- Shape portfolio decisions based on measurable value, risk, adoption, compliance, feasibility, and business impact.

Product Governance, Prioritization & Decision Support

- Establish portfolio-level prioritization approaches that help leaders make clear trade-offs across products, journeys, and capabilities.

- Frame decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders, including outcomes, dependencies, risks, investment needs, and sequencing options.

- Manage strategic dependencies across HR Product, HR Technology, Employee Experience, HR Services, COEs, and enterprise governance forums.

- Surface enterprise-level risks and decisions early, escalating only when broader leadership alignment or investment decisions are required.

AI-Enabled HR Product Innovation

- Lead identification, evaluation, and scaling of AI-enabled HR capabilities across assigned product portfolios.

- Define product expectations for responsible AI use, including trust, transparency, human-in-the-loop controls, quality monitoring, and escalation paths.

- Partner with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Technology, and Compliance teams to ensure AI-enabled capabilities meet enterprise standards and jurisdictional requirements.

- Evaluate vendor releases, emerging technologies, and external product trends to inform future HR product strategy.

Product Performance & Value Realization

- Establish portfolio-level success measures tied to adoption, employee experience, operational effectiveness, self-service, cycle time, containment, and business value.

- Maintain visibility into product performance, benefits realization, portfolio costs, and return on investment.

- Use analytics, listening signals, service trends, workforce insights, and product adoption data to inform roadmap decisions and continuous improvement .

- Ensure product teams move beyond feature delivery to measurable outcomes and sustained value realization.

Product Management Maturity & Operating Model Discipline

- Serve as a thought leader for HR product management practices, reinforcing consistent standards, artifacts, and operating routines.

- Create reusable frameworks for product one-pagers, decision logs, roadmap visibility, scope boundaries, success metrics, and release-readiness expectations.

- Mentor Product Managers and matrixed partners to strengthen product thinking, prioritization discipline, and outcome orientation across HR.

- Advance maturity of McKesson’s HR product operating model by reinforcing single intake, backlog discipline, clear decision rights, and transparent trade-offs.

What Success Looks Like

- HR product portfolios are clearly aligned to enterprise workforce priorities, employee experience standards, and measurable business outcomes.

- Senior leaders have decision-ready visibility into product priorities, dependencies, risks, investments, and value realization.

- AI-enabled HR capabilities are adopted responsibly and reinforce trust, compliance, usability, and business value.

- Product roadmaps reflect integrated experiences rather than isolated tools or projects.

- Product management practices become more consistent, scalable, and outcome-oriented across HR.

- Employees, managers, and HR teams experience more connected, efficient, and trusted HR products over time.

Required Experience

- 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, digital strategy, transformation, HR technology, employee experience, or related disciplines.

- Demonstrated experience shaping enterprise-scale product portfolios, multi-year roadmaps, or complex digital transformation initiatives.

- Experience influencing senior leaders and enterprise prioritization or investment decisions without formal authority.

- Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations with significant cross-functional dependencies.

- Exposure to HR, workforce technology, employee experience, service delivery, or regulated environments preferred.

Required Skills & Competencies

- Strategic product leadership —   connects workforce strategy, employee experience, technology, data, and business outcomes into a clear product direction.

- Portfolio management —   balances competing priorities, dependencies, sequencing, risk, and investment trade-offs across multiple product domains.

- Executive influence —   frames decision-ready recommendations and aligns senior stakeholders without formal authority.

- Systems thinking —   understands how journeys, platforms, processes, data, and operating models interact across the enterprise.

- AI and digital fluency   — understands how to identify, prioritize, govern, and scale AI-enabled capabilities that improve employee experience, productivity, and business outcomes.

- Outcome orientation —   defines success measures, knows the numbers, and manages products toward adoption, value, and continuous improvement.

Leveling Note

Positioned as an individual contributor at Professional P6 (Principal), subject to Compensation confirmation. This role is broader than a single product or journey owner and is intended to provide enterprise-level product leadership across multiple HR product domains, influence portfolio investment decisions, and mature HR product management practices. Distinguished from M5 by the absence of formal people leadership; impact is delivered through enterprise influence, thought leadership, portfolio strategy, and cross-functional product accountability.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Product Manager
jobs.location: Irving, TX, USA - 6555 North State Highway 161 (P001)
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

This role is a hybrid position. The selected candidate is expected to work on-site at our Las Colinas office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in-office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities.

About the Role:

The Sr. Technical Product Manager (TPM) is a strategic and execution-focused role that works is responsible for managing eCommerce Core Ordering digital products with a focus on; Regulatory & Compliance needs, and the Accounts Payable functionality. This individual works with engineering, design, and business teams, translating product vision into actionable technical requirements. Contributes to the product strategy and roadmap by identifying customer needs, business opportunities, and technical considerations within their area of ownership.

This role also engages in identifying and driving the development of new, innovative products. The role demands deep technical acumen, strong analytical skills, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority. Responsibilities include managing the product roadmap, authoring epics and user stories, guiding and interpreting market and user research, and overseeing product performance through data-driven insights.

What You'll Do:

Product Ownership & Execution
- Designs, develops and manages activities for a specific digital product from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life.
- Owns the identification and management of specific features or components within a digital product.
- Translate business requirements into detailed technical requirements and/or specifications.
- Prioritize backlog items in collaboration with engineering and design.
- Drives technical product initiatives within their domain, guiding efforts from ideation and requirements definition through prototyping, validation, pilot execution, and scaled rollout.
- Ensures delivery excellence by aligning product execution with agile best practices, sprint goals, and release timelines, while proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
- Drives the execution and delivery of a digital product, platform, or key product area, supporting activities from discovery and planning through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.

Technical Collaboration
- Work closely with engineering teams to ensure feasibility, scalability, and alignment with architectural standards.
- Managing Trade-off - balance system performance, technical debt, security risks, and delivery speed.
- Participate in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives to promote on-time delivery.
- Understand APIs, data models, and system integrations to guide development.
- Work with engineering and testing teams to develop and apply A/B testing methodologies to validate best-in-class feature and functionality enhancement.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
- Builds strong, trust-based relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including engineering, design, business units, customer success, and executive leadership, to ensure alignment on product goals and priorities.
- Interface with internal stakeholders (e.g., customer success, sales, support) to gather feedback and validate technical solutions.

- Regularly uses immediate customer feedback loops, incorporating customer & user feedback into the prioritization of current product feature expansion, and new product development. Support customer discovery and usability testing to inform product decisions.

Data-Driven Decision Making
- Use real-time analytics tools to monitor product performance, identify issues, and propose improvements.
- Demonstrate measurable improvements in product reliability, scalability, and performance, as reflected in KPIs such as uptime, latency, error rates, and system throughput.
- Drives enhancements that improve user satisfaction, engagement, and retention, measured through NPS, CSAT, adoption rates, and usage analytics.
- Consistently delivers features and improvements on time and within scope, with minimal rework or technical debt, tracked through sprint velocity, cycle time, and release cadence.

Documentation & Communication
- Create and maintain product documentation, including technical specs, release notes, and user guides.
- Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to cross-functional teams.
- Develop and socialize product roadmaps, decision logs, and technical rationale to ensure transparency and alignment across teams.
- Facilitate knowledge transfer and continuity by documenting key product decisions, architectural trade-offs, and lessons learned for future reference and onboarding.

Basic Requirements:

- Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience.
- 7+ years in progressively advancing technical product management roles; less years required if has relevant Master’s or Doctorate qualifications.
- 7+ years proven experience working with and influencing highly matrixed teams.
- Hands-on experience in health care industry and/or regulated environment is a plus.
- Demonstrated understanding of product technical product lifecycle management, agile methodologies, and digital transformation.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

- 7+ years of experience building business cases.
- The following (or similar) certifications are optional but advantageous: Certified Product Manager (CPM); Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.
- Demonstrated ability to engage engineering, architecture, and data teams to evaluate technical trade-offs, influence solution design, and ensure feasibility of product strategies.
- Base understanding of modern digital architectures, APIs, cloud platforms, data ecosystems, and software development practices.

Physical Requirements:

- Traditional Hybrid office environment.
- Commutability to Irving, TX is highly preferred. Candidates within a 50-mile radius of Irving, TX will be required to be onsite 2 days per week.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Data Platforms & Analytics - Healthcare
jobs.location: Irving, TX, USA - 6555 North State Highway 161 (P001)
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

CoverMyMeds’ Shared Capabilities and Partnerships team is looking for a Sr. Product Manager, Data Products & Analytics to join our Enabling Capabilities team and be the primary Product Management contact responsible for a single analytics and platform roadmap. This is a great opportunity to work on highly strategic and quickly evolving capabilities that drive CMM’s future growth. Together with our various business units, the work our team does ultimately helps people get the medicine they need to live healthier lives.

What You'll Do
As a Sr. Product Manager your daily to-dos will shift with business needs, but here’s a snapshot of what to expect:
- Owns the product roadmap for data modernization, data products, and analytics/dashboards delivered back to pharma manufacturers, grounded in the underlying data layout and dimensions of CMM's Access and Affordability products

- Documents business and data requirements into clear, engineering-ready specifications (epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria) for engineering teams to build against

- Operates within a SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) model, writing and refining backlog items, participating in PI Planning, and partnering with Release Train Engineers to sequence delivery

- Partners closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Science, and Data Analytics teams to translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, and reportable outputs

- Conducts structured discovery and feedback interviews with Retail and Specialty Commercial teams to validate data product concepts, prioritize features, and close the loop between build and business need

- Partners with Go-to-Market teams to build enablement assets (training materials, FAQs, positioning) so new data products and dashboards land cleanly with internal and external audiences

- Proactively engages with Product, Commercial and Operations teams to identify value proposition, drive alignment on product evolution, and properly position products in the marketplace

- Makes recommendations to assess product needs and implement solutions across data platforms, teams, and stakeholders of increased complexity and scope

- Uses influence to move teams through buy-in of product direction; encourages engagement and creativity across the team

- Ensures features and product direction are legal and compliant particularly around de-identification and data-sharing standards, collaborating with legal/compliance/privacy teams to triage issues and advise leadership

Required Skills
- Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience.

- Experience in product management or technology product development, ideally within healthcare, pharmacy, or clinical data environments

- Working knowledge of the data layout, dimensions, and relationships underlying CMM's Access and Affordability products (or comparable prior-auth/affordability program data)

- Experience delivering analytics platforms, including familiarity with how data moves through progressive stages from raw collection, to cleansing and integration, to business-ready, reportable form

- Working knowledge of how clinical and pharmacy transaction data, including prescription claims, prior authorization/access, and affordability program data, is structured and connected across systems, and how that structure shapes what analyses and insights are possible

- Experience partnering directly with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and Data Science teams to shape data models and pipelines that feed analytics/reporting layers

- Experience with shared technology platforms and services such as APIs, master data, and visualization tools

- Experience with healthcare data de-identification and data-sharing frameworks, including HIPAA Safe Harbor, Expert Determination, and third-party tokenization solutions (e.g., Datavant)

- Ownership mindset around data quality and trust, defining documentation standards and practices that keep data reliable and reusable across teams, and broader comfort with data privacy and compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA)

- Experience writing detailed product requirements (epics/features/user stories with acceptance criteria) for engineering teams, translating business and data needs into buildable specs

- Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, familiarity with Epic Hypothesis Statements, Feature breakdown, PI Planning, and backlog refinement (Certified SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager a plus)

- Experience running stakeholder interviews/discovery sessions to gather and synthesize feedback on data product concepts

- Experience building go-to-market enablement materials (training, FAQs) for data/analytics products

- Ability to use data strategically to inform product roadmaps and operational decisions, including designing scenario or "what-if" tools that let stakeholders weigh tradeoffs

- Experience developing and prioritizing product roadmaps, balancing new strategic features, growth initiatives, technology improvements, and ongoing sustaining work

- Self-starter who can work through ambiguity collaboratively with cross-functional teams

- Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with both technical and business stakeholders

Preferred Skills
- Prior experience in our relevant product spaces including medication access, affordability, pharmacy and provider networks, and specialty pharmacy is valued.

- Experience with Master Data Management (MDM) and patient mastering/identity resolution across disparate healthcare data sources.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

This role offers location flexibility and is open to candidates across the United States.

Candidates based in the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) area will be hired in a hybrid capacity and are expected to work onsite at our Las Colinas office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in‑office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities.

About the Role:

The Senior Technical Product Manager, AI & Analytics will lead the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery of AI, automation, analytics, and intelligent workflow capabilities across the pharmacy management and Data & Insights platforms.

As part of the Data Strategy & Analytics function, this role will translate customer needs, pharmacy workflows, modernization priorities, and business objectives into scalable product capabilities, clear requirements, prioritized roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
Working across Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, UX, Compliance, Commercial, and Pharmacy Operations, the role will embed actionable insights into pharmacy workflows to improve operational performance, customer experience, and business value. It will also guide the evolution of the Data & Insights Platform into a cloud-native, AI-ready platform delivering governed, scalable data products across EnterpriseRx, CPS, APS, Supplylogix, and future product portfolios.

The Senior Technical Product Manager, AI & Analytics will lead the product strategy and roadmap for the Data & Insights Platform, embedding AI and advanced analytics into the pharmacy platform as core capabilities. This role will translate customer and business needs into scalable solutions that support platform modernization, intelligent insights, workflow innovation, and measurable business value.

What You'll Do:

Lead the Data & Insights Platform Product Strategy
- Define and drive the platform vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes aligned with Pharmacy Systems modernization and the Pharmacy Operating System strategy.
- Evolve the platform into a cloud-native, AI-enabled analytics product that balances scalability, reliability, governance, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
- Lead product strategy for reporting, analytics, self-service insights, data products, AI-powered experiences, and customer-facing intelligence.
- Prioritize Snowflake optimization, governed data access, semantic models, auditability, data quality, lineage, and service-level management.
- Establish unified analytics and data product capabilities across EnterpriseRx, CPS, APS, and Supplylogix to enable governed, cross-domain insights.
- Partner with customers, pharmacy SMEs, UX, Commercial teams, and Product Owners to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into measurable outcomes.
- Define product requirements, MVP scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, KPIs, and success measures.
- Own roadmap and backlog prioritization informed by customer feedback, market analysis, business value, and technical feasibility.
- Partner with Commercial and Finance teams on packaging, entitlements, adoption, monetization, cost-to-serve, and value realization.
- Lead design-partner engagements, pilots, product launches, and go-to-market readiness.

Define the AI Product Vision and Roadmap
- Develop the AI strategy and roadmap for the Data & Insights Platform and broader Pharmacy Operating System.

- Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve decisions, enhance user experiences, and increase operational efficiency.

- Translate modernization objectives into scalable AI-enabled capabilities that create customer and business value.

- Ensure AI solutions align with platform principles for scalability, configurability, multi-tenancy, security, governance, and reuse.

- Establish requirements for explainability, responsible AI, monitoring, user feedback, adoption, and trustworthy outputs.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science teams to validate, prioritize, and scale AI capabilities.

Drive Cross-Functional Product Delivery
- Serve as the Product Management lead for data, analytics, reporting, and AI platform capabilities.

- Collaborate with Engineering, Architecture, UX, Data Strategy, Security, Compliance, Commercial, and Pharmacy Operations to deliver roadmap commitments.

- Define functional and non-functional requirements for analytics and AI-enabled workflows.

- Ensure solutions are scalable, configurable, secure, multi-tenant, and operationally resilient.

- Lead backlog prioritization, sprint planning, UAT, release readiness, and delivery governance.

- Align platform capabilities with APIs, event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, and reusable platform services.

- Monitor adoption, performance, customer outcomes, and product value to guide continuous improvement.

Basic Requirements:

- Degree or equivalent and typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience.

- 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Platform Product Management, or Product Strategy.
- Experience leading complex SaaS, enterprise software, workflow, healthcare technology, or data platform products.
- Strong understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, automation, analytics, and data products from a product management perspective.
- Ability to translate technical and AI concepts into customer-facing capabilities, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
- Experience partnering with Engineering, Architecture, UX, Data, Analytics, Security, Compliance, and Commercial teams.
- Experience managing analytics, reporting, dashboard, visualization, self-service, or cloud data platform products.
- Strong skills in product discovery, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, MVP definition, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
- Experience operating in complex, regulated enterprise environments.
- Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

- Experience with pharmacy management systems, healthcare technology, pharmacy operations, claims, adjudication, inventory management, or clinical workflows.
- Experience with Snowflake, Looker, or comparable cloud data and business intelligence platforms, including governed analytics, query optimization, workload management, and cost controls.
- Experience launching AI-powered products, workflow automation, copilots, recommendation engines, or decision-support tools.
- Familiarity with product telemetry, usage analytics, experimentation, and outcome measurement.
- Experience developing customer-facing analytics, self-service insights, or data monetization strategies.
- Knowledge of modern data architecture, data governance, and AI governance practices.

This technology product leader owns the roadmap that drives revenue, customer growth and retention for the Supplylogix business. This includes accountability for product strategy, commercial performance, and delivery of the inventory intelligence SaaS platform that is serving over 10,000 pharmacy locations.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

Commercial & Customer Relationships

Product Management Leadership

Platform & Cross-Product Area Integration

Team Leadership & Talent Development
Build, lead, manage, develop and retain the combined product team.

- Familiarity with building AI tools and workflows to accelerate product development velocity.

Candidates based in the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) area will be hired in a hybrid capacity and are expected to work onsite at our Las Colinas office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in‑office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities.

About the Role:

The Product Operations Analyst will execute the definition of product performance tracking and portfolio insights and strategic reporting for the operating model across Pharmacy Management, Clinical Service and Inventory Optimization technology products.

This role will be responsible for AI-forward product performance standards that drive customer experience and growth across products. This individual sits at the intersection of product operations, data, and engineering to drive product health reporting and performance dashboard infrastructure definition, visualization, and review cadences. Furthermore, this role will partner closely with Product, Data Insights, and Customer Success teams on portfolio-level metric level definition and synthesize customer insights to delineate data decisions that accelerate product delivery.

Reporting to the Director of Product Operations & Strategy, this individual implements and refines data methodologies across the product organization. This role drives operational outcomes focused on actionable, evidence-based insights that guide product growth and business outcomes.

This role works closely with Product Leadership, Engineering, Customer Success, Data Insights, Commercial teams and other McKesson organizations to drive our strategic objectives and operational efficiency and support business growth.

McKesson Pharmacy System (MPS) is an independent business within the larger McKesson Commercial Strategy & Innovation (CSI) organization.

What You'll Do:

Product Performance Tracking
- Maintain and update the KPI taxonomy that defines how product health is measured and reported across the portfolio; use AI tools to ensure metrics are consistently defined and comparable while accommodating different business models.

- Build and maintain product performance dashboards; coordinate with Engineering teams to ensure the underlying instrumentation, data access, and visualizations are accurate and current.

- Craft templates and materials for product performance reviews; track the review cadence, follow up with PMs to collect inputs on schedule, and ensure submissions are grounded in data rather than qualitative narrative for executive audiences.

- Monitor product performance data on a recurring basis to identify early-warning signals; flag risks to relevant leads and support the escalation process by pulling the right data and engaging the right stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success.

- Aggregate and analyze product performance data across the product portfolio using AI tools to accelerate pattern recognition and prepare evidence-based insights that inform resource reallocation, acceleration, or sunset recommendations.

Portfolio Insights & Strategic Reporting
- Synthesize data across product areas into a coherent narrative for leadership and flag anomalies or emerging risks proactively.

- Prepare executive summaries and KPI tracking templates; ensure all reporting is grounded in current data and formatted for the intended audience.

- Aggregate VOC data using AI-powered analysis to surface themes and patterns at scale; collaborate cross-functionally to maintain the feedback taxonomy and routing process to ensure insights reach the right leaders.

- Monitor the competitive landscape on a recurring basis; compile and summarize market intelligence, competitor product updates, and industry signals into impactful narratives that inform product and portfolio decisions.

- Champion the use of AI to identify recurring gaps or inconsistencies in how performance data is collected and reported across the portfolio.

Product Operating Model Maturity
- Execute and continuously evaluate the scoring process for the product prioritization framework.

- Build core deliverables for PM training, onboarding, and enablement, leveraging AI to accelerate content development and refinement.

- Prepare materials to support coaching of PMs on prioritization, ROI sizing, experimentation, and planning.

- Support the administration of AI tooling that rapidly accelerates product operational workflows and reusable templates for product development.

- Identify opportunities to embed AI into operational workflows and champion adoption of AI-powered productivity practices across the product organization.

Product Strategy Development
- Utilize AI-led tools and research concepts to capture critical data points regarding competitive landscape, customer needs, and market trends that influence decisions for the product strategy.

- Monitor roadmap inputs and progress and identify key data points for opportunity areas to accelerate delivery across the product portfolio.

Basic Requirements:

- Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience.
- 4+ years of progressive experience in product management, product operations, technology consulting, analytics, or related technology transformation roles.

- Strong experience with Claude, Rovo, Figma or equivalent AI-first product tools to accelerate product development.

- Strong data analysis acumen with experience in Excel, SQL, R, Python or other comparable BI tools such as Power BI, Looker and Tableau.

- Strong understanding of product metrics fluency, dashboard reporting infrastructure, and prioritization frameworks.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to collaborate with multiple, concurrent work streams and meet deadlines reliably.

- Strong cross-functional facilitation and collaboration: able to engage product, engineering, data, design, customer success and commercial leaders, to influence conversations, mitigate issues / decisions, document outcomes, and drive accountability.

- Strong analytical fluency governing product metric definitions, measuring product health, assessing product KPI taxonomy, and extracting insights from data within context in collaboration with cross-functional partners.

- Clear written communication and storytelling skills with the ability to produce clean, readable documentation and leadership-ready narrative.

- Comfortable coordinating across teams and following up on action items without formal authority.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

- Experience with AI/automation tools for product management and design workflow acceleration.

- Experience supporting operating mechanisms for multi-product platform organizations where the operating model itself is a transformation deliverable.

- Familiarity with technical product concepts, cloud platforms, data ecosystems, and API-driven models is beneficial.

- Experience in healthcare, pharmacy operations, supply chain, or predictive analytics domains.

- Up to 10% travel required for cross-site collaboration and customer/partner engagements.

jobs.title: CoverMyMeds Product Marketing Intern- Summer 2027
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About the Role
This summer, you'll join a B2B healthcare product marketing team and help accelerate its impact — using AI to move from one-off prompts to autonomous, workflow-level agents that change how the team operates. CoverMyMeds is seeking a curious, analytical intern interested in the craft of product marketing (positioning, messaging, buyer insight, enablement, go-to-market) and sees AI as a force multiplier for that craft, not a substitute for it.

The ideal candidate is a marketer at heart: passionate about understanding buyers, shaping how products are positioned and brought to market, and telling stories that resonate — and excited to apply AI to do all of it faster, sharper, and at greater scale.

What You'll Do
- Doing the PMM work, faster — you'll help drive smarter product marketing workstreams — product positioning and messaging, buyer and competitive insights, commercial enablement, go-to-market support — and use AI to move through them.
- Moving from assistants to agents — help us graduate from one-off AI prompts to repeatable, semi-autonomous workflows that run parts of our process.
- Driving participation — be a champion for AI adoption across the team: demo tools, run enablement sessions, lower the barrier to entry for teammates who are AI-curious but not yet AI-confident.
- Measuring success — help define what "AI-enabled product marketing impact" means, then build the tracking.
- Optimizing impact with AI — find the highest-leverage places where AI can speed up actionable market signals, sharpen messaging, or scale our output, and prove it with results.
- Where you might plug in (you won't do all of these — you'll go deep where the business needs you most): - Positioning & messaging
- Personas & segmentation
- Sales enablement
- Go-to-market planning

What You'll Gain
- Hands-on experience in B2B healthcare technology and product marketing, with a dedicated mentor.
- Exposure to how a Fortune-class healthcare business runs product marketing.
- Ownership of 1-2 projects, giving experience applying AI and automation to real business challenges.
- Opportunities to influence how a modern marketing organization evolves from traditional workflows to AI-powered ways of working.

Qualifications
- A marketing student — pursuing Marketing, Business, Communications, or related degree— with a genuine interest in product marketing craft (positioning, messaging, buyer insight) and a curiosity for AI amplification.
- Strong interest in AI, marketing technology, and innovation.
- Excellent research, analytical, and communication skills.
- Experience with generative AI tools such as Copilot, Writer, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar.
- Comfort with ambiguity, a bias towards action and curiosity about healthcare

Success in This Role
By the end of the internship, you will have helped increase Product Marketing output, accelerated research and content development, improved AI adoption across key workflows, and contributed to measurable gains in team efficiency and strategic impact.

Join us in helping redefine the future of Product Marketing through AI.
